valid.name: integer-scalars
valid.description: The minimum, maximum and a value of distinct bytes of every integer type

valid.name: float-scalars
valid.description: For each float type: a value that's exact, one that rounds, -0, both infinities, NaN, the largest finite value and the smallest subnormal one

valid.name: integer-arrays
valid.description: An array of every integer type, of its extremes, -1, 0, 1 and a value of distinct bytes

valid.name: float-arrays
valid.description: Arrays of the float values of float-scalars and 0

valid.name: empty-arrays
valid.description: An empty array of every element type. Their lengths are padded as they would be for elements, so the int64[] and uint64[] each follow 4 bytes of padding.

valid.name: padding
valid.description: A uint8[] of 0 to 7 bytes before each of eight float64[], of 0 to 3 bytes before each of four int32[] and of 0 to 1 bytes before each of two uint16[], so that the arrays are padded by every amount that they can be

valid.name: offset-type-uint8
valid.description: uint8 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint8-sized
valid.description: uint8 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint8-versioned
valid.description: uint8 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a version slot of 255, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint8-sized-versioned
valid.description: uint8 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot and a version slot of 255, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint16
valid.description: uint16 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint16-sized
valid.description: uint16 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint16-versioned
valid.description: uint16 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a version slot of 65535, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint16-sized-versioned
valid.description: uint16 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot and a version slot of 65535, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint32
valid.description: uint32 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint32-sized
valid.description: uint32 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint32-versioned
valid.description: uint32 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a version slot of 4294967295, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint32-sized-versioned
valid.description: uint32 offsets, lengths, counts and item ends after a size slot and a version slot of 4294967295, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, a struct, an array of structs, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-type-uint8-full
valid.description: The longest table of uint8 offsets, 255 bytes: its size, the length 250 of its uint8[] and the offset 254 of its last field are only read correctly unsigned

valid.name: strings
valid.description: Strings: empty, ASCII, with 2-, 3- and 4-byte UTF-8 sequences, with a leading U+FEFF, which is part of the string rather than a byte order mark, U+FEFF alone, with a NUL inside and mixing every sequence length

valid.name: structs
valid.description: Struct fields, which are unpadded like scalars: of one uint8 after a uint8; of every scalar type, each a value of distinct bytes, so that the order of the scalars and of their bytes shows; and of a float32, a float64 and an int16 of -0, NaN and -2

valid.name: struct-arrays
valid.description: Arrays of structs, each padded so that its structs start at a multiple of their largest scalar's size: an empty array of structs of a uint8 and a float64, padded to 8; after a uint8 each, arrays of structs of two uint8s, aligned to 1; of a uint16 and a uint8, of 3 bytes aligned to 2; of three float32s, aligned to 4, with -0 and NaN; and of a uint8 and a float64, of 9 bytes aligned to 8, whose float64s aren't aligned in the structs after the first; then an array of a struct of every integer type

valid.name: nested-tables
valid.description: The same table nested from its builder, padded to 8 for its float64[]; from its bytes, padded to the default of 4 and then to 8; and from its builder with an alignment of 1, unpadded. Then an empty table from its builder, unpadded, and from its bytes, padded to 4.

valid.name: nested-two-deep
valid.description: A table nested in a table nested in a sized and versioned table, from the middle table's builder and from its bytes. The int64[] at the bottom pads both nested tables to 8.

valid.name: nested-narrower-offsets
valid.description: Tables of uint8 and uint16 offsets nested in a table of uint32 offsets, from their builders, which are written with their own offsets, and from bytes. Each is read from its position with its own offset type.

valid.name: nested-wider-offsets
valid.description: Tables of uint32 and uint16 offsets nested from their builders in a table of uint8 offsets. Each is read from its position with its own offset type.

valid.name: vectors
valid.description: Vectors of rows from their builders and of the same rows from their bytes, after the end of each row, whose float64[]s are aligned within each row, but mostly not in the table, since items aren't padded; an empty vector, which is its count alone; and a vector of an empty table from its builder and from its bytes, whose ends are equal

valid.name: vector-item-layouts
valid.description: A vector of a table read in place and then tables of other layouts, which are read from their items' bytes: of uint16 offsets, which its builder writes and the vector copies; with a size and a version, written straight into the vector; and of uint8 offsets with both, from bytes

valid.name: empty-table
valid.description: A table of no fields, which has no bytes

valid.name: empty-table-sized-versioned
valid.description: A table of no fields with uint16 size and version slots

invalid.name: truncated-offsets
invalid.description: Cut inside the offset of the first field

invalid.name: truncated-array
invalid.description: Cut inside the last element of the last array

invalid.name: truncated-string
invalid.description: Cut inside the last character of the last string

invalid.name: truncated-offset-type-uint8
invalid.description: offset-type-uint8-full without its last byte, its last field

invalid.name: offset-past-end
invalid.description: The offset of the first field, an int8, points at the end of the table

invalid.name: array-length-past-end
invalid.description: The length of the last array counts one element more than the table holds

invalid.name: array-length-max
invalid.description: The length of the first array is 2^32 - 1, which a reader must not allocate

invalid.name: array-length-max-offset-type-uint16
invalid.description: The uint16 length of the float64[] of offset-type-uint16 is 2^16 - 1

invalid.name: string-length-past-end
invalid.description: The length of the last string counts one byte more than the table holds

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-continuation
invalid.description: A string starts with a continuation byte, 0x80

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-overlong
invalid.description: A string has an overlong encoding of "/", 0xc0 0xaf

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-surrogate
invalid.description: A string has the encoded surrogate U+D800, 0xed 0xa0 0x80

invalid.name: vector-count-past-end
invalid.description: The item count of a vector is 2^32 - 1

invalid.name: vector-item-past-end
invalid.description: The end of the last item of the vector is one byte past the end of the table

invalid.name: vector-item-ends-before-start
invalid.description: The end of the first item of the vector is one byte before its start, which is right after the four ends

invalid.name: struct-past-end
invalid.description: Cut inside the last scalar of the last struct

invalid.name: struct-array-count-past-end
invalid.description: The count of the last array of structs counts one struct more than the table holds

invalid.name: struct-array-count-max
invalid.description: The count of the array of structs of three float32s is 2^32 - 1, which a reader must not allocate for

invalid.name: nested-offset-past-end
invalid.description: The offset of the string of the first nested table is 2^32 - 1, past the end even before it's added to the nested table's position
